responsibility: Owns the shipment lifecycle, including shipment registration, tracking identifier assignment, origin/destination/deadline rules, destination changes, route assignment and replanning decisions, shipment operational status, and administrative/tracking views of shipments.

Records and audits logistics events from operational, integration, mobile, REST, and file-based channels; validates event references to shipments, locations, voyages, and trips; retains event history and rejected attempts; and notifies shipment management when valid events affect shipment status.

Provides route and itinerary planning capabilities, including candidate route calculation, route compatibility checks against origin, destination, deadline, voyages, trips, and logistics locations, and support data for route and event validation.
